## Football effect

Stanford played 33 defensive snaps with seven tackles, two sacks of Griffin (for 4 on third-and-6 in the second quarter and for 10 on second-and-3 in the third, both over Trent Williams's slot and both ending a Washington possession in a punt), a pass defended on the first throw of Washington's two-minute drive and two pressures, all after the injury was logged at the end of Washington's first possession. On the projection he misses the Wednesday and Thursday practices of the Indianapolis week; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. Sio Moore and Telvin Smith are the chart's next linebackers behind him. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
